purpose: Canonical registry of every Golden-validation artefact. Three different digests have been called 'the Golden hash'; they are three DIFFERENT artefacts with different serializers and different machine-independence. Every comparison must name the artefact it compares, by the ids below.

golden.entry_trades.file.v1.description: The primary Golden oracle: the entry-scenario trades CSV as written to disk by the driver.
golden.entry_trades.file.v1.generator: src.resume_support.save_scenario_csv(df, path, write_marker=False) after assign_execution_trade_numbers(df); underlying serializer pandas DataFrame.to_csv(index=False)

serialization.float_format: pandas default (shortest round-trip repr per value)
serialization.timezone_rendering: as carried in the frame; detection/fill times are '+00:00'-suffixed strings, state_known_at is 'Z'-suffixed

golden.entry_trades.file.v1.machine_independence_note: PROVEN machine-dependent: the four regime diagnostic floats (ema_value, px_vs_ema, bbw_value, adx_value) are produced by vectorised rolling().mean/std(ddof=1) and ewm reductions whose summation order differs across CPU architecture and BLAS/numpy builds. Observed: S_22 bbw_value 2.540400593491076 (Mac producer) vs 2.540400593491075 (VPS) - exactly 2 ULP as parsed doubles (measured; shortest repr is bijective), classification unaffected (fixed threshold 2.342).

known_digests.vps_windows_observed: 7febbb3464e9bb58 (prefix as reported; full value recorded VPS-side)

golden.entry_trades.file.v1.digest_semantics: A digest of this artefact is only comparable BETWEEN RUNS ON THE SAME HOST AND ENVIRONMENT. Cross-machine comparison must use the field-level archive policy, never the byte hash.

golden.baseline_trades.file.v1.description: Baseline (protection=baseline) trades CSV written by the same driver path.

harness.entry_trades.mem.v1.description: In-memory digest used by the capacity/optimisation equivalence harness: sha256 of frame.astype(str).to_csv(index=False) computed on the RAW golden_pipeline return, WITHOUT save_scenario_csv's execution-number column pass and WITHOUT touching disk. A different serializer over (nearly) the same logical frame - NOT interchangeable with golden.entry_trades.file.v1.

serialization.float_format: python str() per cell after astype(str)

harness.entry_trades.mem.v1.machine_independence_note: astype(str) renders the same shortest-round-trip repr, so the same four diagnostic floats make this digest cross-machine-unstable too.
harness.entry_trades.mem.v1.digest_semantics: same-host only; evidence artefact for optimisation equivalence runs, never a deployment gate

same_host_deployment_gate.statement: A candidate is promotable ONLY if it is byte-identical to production run on the SAME host, same inputs, same environment - full file bytes AND full field census. No tolerances of any kind.

cross_machine_archive_witness.statement: The Mac-produced archive is a regression WITNESS, not the deployment-host oracle. Field-level comparison with an explicit allowlist; every mismatch is enumerated; any mismatch outside the allowlist, or beyond max_ulp inside it, fails.
cross_machine_archive_witness.allowlist_rationale: The exact four write-only regime diagnostics mapped at strategy_core/execution.py:361-366 ('Pure mapping - no indicator math'). Classification consumes the underlying values against a FIXED threshold (bbwThresholdMode=fixed, 2.342); any economic effect of a float flip would surface in market_state/volatility_state/outcome/net_r, all of which remain zero-tolerance.
cross_machine_archive_witness.max_ulp_rationale: MEASURED, not preferred: the observed S_22 pair (2.540400593491076 archive vs 2.540400593491075 VPS) parses to doubles exactly 2 ULP apart - shortest round-trip repr is bijective, so these are the true computed values. A 1-ULP bound would reject the only real-world case on record.
cross_machine_archive_witness.known_input_drift: Cells listed in live/golden_known_input_drift.json are reclassified as explained_input_drift ONLY on an exact match of key+field+ref+cand. They are input drift, not tolerance: widening them requires a new dataset-revision investigation, never an edit to this policy.

input_pinning.statement: Every artefact digest is a function of (engine, inputs). The archive digests are pinned to the ARCHIVE-ERA inputs and are NOT reproducible from a clean checkout: the archive-era dataset (314a0efa…) was replaced on 2026-08-02 by a rebuilt file (ba32de0d…) whose historical revisions change 3 counterfactual analytics cells, and the archived candle copy is absent from the repo. The committed news file (7e37fc88…) is the archive-consistent one; the Mac working tree additionally carries an UNCOMMITTED news refresh (85c25c35…) that produces 698 news-field differences if used - clean checkouts are immune.
